mood: A quiet practice notebook: cream staff paper and fountain-pen ink by day, a night manuscript in pale ink by night. Calm, literal, for beginners.

fonts.display: System book serif (Iowan Old Style, Palatino, Georgia); italic for handwritten-feeling tags

shape.texture: Paper grain from two faint CSS dot lattices; no raster texture

motifs: noteheads, stems, rests and bar lines
treble clef on the live staff
buttonStyle: Primary is a filled indigo ink pill with paper-coloured text; secondary is an outlined pill in navy ink.
backdrop: A band of staff paper across the top of the app (the staves are CSS); notes, rests and the odd bar line drift slowly left (5-11 px/s), and a note the learner plays pops onto a staff at its pitch in the accent and drifts away. Canvas, pure renderer in lib/rmhmusic/learn/backdrop/scene.ts.
motion: Slow drifts only; nothing flashes (a played note fades in over 0.35 s). Jelly motion Still stops the backdrop on one frame; the loop also stops while the tab is hidden or the band is off screen.
